rules.sql: SELECT min(value_date) AS min_value_date, max(value_date) AS max_value_date, count(*) AS valuation_rows, CASE WHEN count(*) = 1 AND min(value_date) = :valueDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS requested_date_current FROM dbsystemuat.valuation_date_table

SELECT upper(substring_index(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS matlab_client, count(*) AS row_count, min(c.value_date) AS min_value_date, max(c.value_date) AS max_value_date, sum(CASE WHEN c.value_date = :valueDate THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS off_date_rows, sum(c.mtm_usd) AS sum_mtm_usd FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs c WHERE c.derivative_type = 'future' AND upper(substring_index(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN (:clientA, :clientB) GROUP BY upper(substring_index(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) ORDER BY matlab_client

SELECT upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS matlab_client, count(*) AS row_count, min(c.value_date) AS min_value_date, max(c.value_date) AS max_value_date, sum(CASE WHEN c.value_date = :valueDate THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS off_date_rows, sum(c.mtm_usd) AS sum_mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.derivative_type = 'future' AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN (:clientA, :clientB) GROUP BY upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) ORDER BY matlab_client

SELECT upper(substring_index(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS matlab_client, c.trade_id, c.value_date, c.settlement_date, c.instrument, c.subportfolio, c.product_code, c.derivative_type, c.market_action, c.original_lots, c.active_lots, c.currency, c.transaction_date, c.maturity_date, c.contract_month, c.underlying1_id, c.underlying2_id, c.underlying1_price, c.underlying2_price, c.future_expiry, c.counterparty_parent, c.client_code, c.contract_number, c.barrier1_hit, c.traded_price, c.future_price, c.lot_mult, c.curr_mult, c.mult_factor, c.nc_factor, c.fx_nc_factor, c.netting_status, c.opt_periodicity, c.is_premium_paid, c.fixing_date, c.settle_price, c.mtm_nc, c.mtm_usd, c.mtm_usd_spot, c.mkt_value_nc, c.mkt_value_usd, c.premium_paid_nc, c.premium_paid_usd, c.trade_direction FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cfs c WHERE c.derivative_type = 'future' AND upper(substring_index(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN (:clientA, :clientB)

SELECT upper(substring_index(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS matlab_client, c.trade_id, c.value_date, c.settlement_date, c.instrument, c.subportfolio, c.product_code, c.derivative_type, c.market_action, c.original_lots, c.active_lots, c.currency, c.transaction_date, c.maturity_date, c.contract_month, c.underlying1_id, c.underlying2_id, c.underlying1_price, c.underlying2_price, c.future_expiry, c.counterparty_parent, c.client_code, c.contract_number, c.barrier1_hit, c.traded_price, c.future_price, c.lot_mult, c.curr_mult, c.mult_factor, c.nc_factor, c.fx_nc_factor, c.netting_status, c.opt_periodicity, c.is_premium_paid, c.fixing_date, c.settle_price, c.mtm_nc, c.mtm_usd, c.mtm_usd_spot, c.mkt_value_nc, c.mkt_value_usd, c.premium_paid_nc, c.premium_paid_usd, c.trade_direction FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs c WHERE c.derivative_type = 'future' AND upper(substring_index(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN (:clientA, :clientB)

SELECT upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS matlab_client, c.trade_id, c.value_date, c.settlement_date, c.instrument, c.subportfolio, c.product_code, c.derivative_type, c.market_action, c.original_lots, c.active_lots, c.currency, c.transaction_date, c.maturity_date, c.contract_month, c.underlying1_id, c.underlying2_id, c.underlying1_price, c.underlying2_price, c.future_expiry, c.counterparty_parent, c.client_code, c.contract_number, c.barrier1_hit, c.traded_price, c.future_price, c.lot_mult, c.curr_mult, c.mult_factor, c.nc_factor, c.fx_nc_factor, c.netting_status, c.opt_periodicity, c.is_premium_paid, c.fixing_date, c.settle_price, c.mtm_nc, c.mtm_usd, c.mtm_usd_spot, c.mkt_value_nc, c.mkt_value_usd, c.premium_paid_nc, c.premium_paid_usd, c.trade_direction FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.derivative_type = 'future' AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN (:clientA, :clientB)

SELECT table_name, view_definition FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND table_name IN ('helper_client_statement_report_view_cfs', 'deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view_cfs', 'deal_ticket_active_lots_view_cfs', 'helper_deal_ticket_active_lots_view_cfs', 'helper_calculated_settle_price_view_cfs', 'helper_calculate_future_price_view_cfs', 'helper_otc_multiplier_view', 'murex_nc_factor_view', 'fx_nc_factor_view_cfs') ORDER BY table_name
SELECT routine_name, last_altered, routine_definition FROM information_schema.routines WHERE routine_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND routine_name = 'create_client_statement_cache_table_cfs'

SELECT column_name, column_type, numeric_precision, numeric_scale, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND table_name = 'helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs' AND column_name IN ('trade_id', 'value_date', 'settlement_date', 'instrument', 'subportfolio', 'product_code', 'derivative_type', 'market_action', 'original_lots', 'active_lots', 'currency', 'transaction_date', 'maturity_date', 'contract_month', 'underlying1_id', 'underlying2_id', 'underlying1_price', 'underlying2_price', 'future_expiry', 'counterparty_parent', 'client_code', 'contract_number', 'barrier1_hit', 'traded_price', 'future_price', 'lot_mult', 'curr_mult', 'mult_factor', 'nc_factor', 'fx_nc_factor', 'netting_status', 'opt_periodicity', 'is_premium_paid', 'fixing_date', 'settle_price', 'mtm_nc', 'mtm_usd', 'mtm_usd_spot', 'mkt_value_nc', 'mkt_value_usd', 'premium_paid_nc', 'premium_paid_usd', 'trade_direction') ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT column_name, data_type, udt_name, numeric_precision, numeric_scale, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'opera' AND table_name = 'helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table' AND column_name IN ('trade_id', 'value_date', 'settlement_date', 'instrument', 'subportfolio', 'product_code', 'derivative_type', 'market_action', 'original_lots', 'active_lots', 'currency', 'transaction_date', 'maturity_date', 'contract_month', 'underlying1_id', 'underlying2_id', 'underlying1_price', 'underlying2_price', 'future_expiry', 'counterparty_parent', 'client_code', 'contract_number', 'barrier1_hit', 'traded_price', 'future_price', 'lot_mult', 'curr_mult', 'mult_factor', 'nc_factor', 'fx_nc_factor', 'netting_status', 'opt_periodicity', 'is_premium_paid', 'fixing_date', 'settle_price', 'mtm_nc', 'mtm_usd', 'mtm_usd_spot', 'mkt_value_nc', 'mkt_value_usd', 'premium_paid_nc', 'premium_paid_usd', 'trade_direction') ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments, md5(p.prosrc) AS body_hash, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS function_definition FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND p.proname IN ('fn_refresh_client_statement_positions', 'fn_client_statement_snapshots', 'fn_statement_position_summaries_v2') ORDER BY p.proname, arguments
